slides: Conservative is just cowardice dressed up
You pick the safe choice every single morning
The shirt your mom would approve of
The color that makes you disappear
AND EVERYONE AROUND YOU KNOWS WHY YOU DRESSED THAT WAY
Fear picks your clothes Discipline does too
Dress like you want to be seen Follow for the rules
caption:
Your closet holds your fear. Most men do. That's not mindset or discipline. One bold element ends that habit.

A strong watch says you decided to be seen. A chain says you're not afraid of standing out. A bold shirt says you chose yourself over comfort.

These elements broadcast something most men never dare to signal.

Fear is a choice. So is courage.

Send this to a man who needs it today.
